record.field: Holders may mint API keys with scope "real_estate_api" and call the catalog endpoints anonymously is not gated by this group — but interest submission, embed token minting, and admin views on captured leads ARE.
Manage embed tokens (mint, revoke, audit) and view the rate-limit counter table for diagnostics.

Grants access to the top-level (non-by-ref) download endpoints: /api/v1/contracts/<id>/download, /api/v1/installments/<id>/invoice, /api/v1/payments/<id>/{invoice,receipt}, /api/v1/contracts/<id>/documents.zip.
Per-customer by-ref download endpoints stay ungated (any valid API key can reach them, but each caller only ever sees the partner they resolve by external_ref).
